rows.contract: Native class is usable from Azahar and renderer-side Objective-C++ with SDK types.
rows.native_mapping: Use a real consumption TU for exact ABI, compiled with enabled and disabled FreeCam, transitive graph checked without private headers.
rows.expected_result: Consumer compiles and linked arithmetic/oracles run independently of physical Metal device.

rows.actual_result: Actual Apple arm64 ARC header consumer compiled, including FreeCam; exhaustive 65536 unsigned indexes, truncation and rotated normalized coordinates ran; transitive dependency audit clean; PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 passes plus 5 skips.
